Spray Foam Removal, Insulation and Roofing Services

We're roofers as well as spray foam removal and insulation specialists, so one directly employed team can survey the roof, take the foam out, insulate the loft and repair or replace the roof.

Spray Foam Insulation RemovalSpray foam stripped from the rafters, the timbers cleaned and every stage photographed for your lender. Loft Insulation Installation and UpgradesOld insulation out, the loft vacuumed, then Knauf or Rockwool laid to 300mm. SuperFOIL InsulationSF19 and SF40 fitted to the maker's specification, with the right air gaps and sealed joints. Roof ReplacementOld roofs stripped to the rafters, then new membrane, treated battens, tiles and lead. Roof RepairsLeadwork, leaks and damage found under spray foam, repaired with the right materials. Roof Ventilation and Condensation ControlCondensation traced to its cause, then lap vents and dry ridge ventilation where they will fix it. Roofing and Spray Foam SurveysSpecialist surveys with photos, moisture readings and clear recommendations.
